notes.title: New Milestone!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Sainthood has now officially welcomed over 2,500 players into acts of faith, hope, and charity.

From the bottom of my heart: thank you for stepping onto the island, for lending your time, your curiosity, and your spirit to this little world we built. Your support means the world to me.

I created Sainthood simply because I wanted a cozy faith-based game to exist, and to put a positive light on what it means to be Catholic.

To see so many of you embrace it — and to see so many beautiful reviews (over 95% positive on both Steam & Xbox!) — is a blessing I don't take for granted. Please, keep those reviews coming! It really helps the Steam Algorithm and helps me make a better game!

✨ What's next?
I'm taking it one step at a time — fixing bugs, adding to the Prayer Mode, and exploring new ideas both within and outside the game (charity/sponsorships, anyone?).

If you’d like to follow along, come join the Discord! https://discord.com/invite/3NZdTqDVda

Thank you again for believing in this project.

See you on the island,
- Bisong.

notes.title: Support for Ultrawide screens and more Quality of life Fixes!
notes.content:
I've added a few quality of life updates:


 Added support for Ultrawide screens
 Rebalanced a few provisions
 Upgrading buildings now takes time, and also takes provisions into account
 A few text updates to make things clearer
 Bug fixes


Let me know your feedback! 😇

notes.title: SAINTHOOD is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Happy All Saints Day!

And of course, a very happy launch day for SAINTHOOD!😇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/dce8f9a848284906e79bb49c6e9af1aa3a74b425.png

SAINTHOOD is now live on Steam with a 10% off launch discount! It's time to play a new kind of game, where serving others and deepening your faith is at its heart.

[previewyoutube=vqM4Dz7KRPo;full][/previewyoutube]

Words cannot express how happy I am to finally get this game out the door! It's been four long years but we finally made it! Many thanks to the team and all who have supported my vision from its inception.

And of course a very special thanks to YOU, dear player, who have chosen to spend your time and money on my little experiment. ❤️

One last thing, Steam reviews are incredibly helpful for small games like mine, so every review counts (good or constructive). Please take a minute to leave a thoughtful review about your experience with the game after playing!

BUY NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1748600/Sainthood/

notes.title: New Demo and Steam Next Fest in October!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/fdb7eeb97f20f7d822b5e803b23cfe131cff26b5.jpg

I'm excited to announce that a brand new demo for Sainthood is live and ready for you to play! 😇✝️


Immerse yourself in a miniature world focused on transcendence in the latest demo of my cozy strategy game, Sainthood - full game releasing Fall 2024. 🌿🕊️

Also, mark your calendars – Sainthood will be featured in Steam Next Fest this October! Don’t miss out on a special livestream hosted by none other than myself!

But you don't have to wait. Play the demo now, add it to your wishlist, share with a friend, and let me know what you think!

Cheers!
- Bisong.
